headlines.title: Growth in China’s factory-gate prices accelerates, but consumer inflation subdued
headlines.summary:
Growth in Chinese factory-gate prices continued to accelerate last month, while consumer price growth remained subdued despite Beijing’s efforts to shore up domestic demand and support the economy in meeting its annual growth target.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5 per cent year on year in September, the highest rate since mid-2022, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday. It rose by 3.8 per cent in August.
The reading beat a projection of 4.3 per cent...
headlines.title_zh: 中国工业生产者出厂价格涨幅加快，但消费者通胀低迷
headlines.summary_zh:
中国出厂价格上月继续加速上涨，而尽管北京方面努力提振国内需求并支持经济实现年度增长目标，消费者价格涨幅仍保持低迷。
数据显示，9月份生产者价格指数（PPI）同比上涨5%，为2022年年中以来的最高水平。

headlines.title: 英国所持美债超过1万亿美元，日本所持美债持创2024年12月以来新低
headlines.summary: 美国财政部数据显示，美国8月主要海外美债持仓分化。 日本持仓降至1.068万亿美元，创2024年12月以来的最低位，环比减少360亿美元。 作为第二大持有国，英国持仓则升至1.010万亿美元——首次突破1万亿美元大关，增加120亿美元。 8月中国持有的美国国债降至5910亿美元，较7月减少270亿美元。

headlines.title_en: UK holdings of US Treasuries exceed $1 trillion; Japan's holdings hit a new low since December 2024
headlines.summary_en: U.S. Treasury Department data show that major overseas holdings of U.S. Treasuries diverged in August. Japan's holdings fell to $1.068 trillion, the lowest since December 2024, down $36 billion month on month. The United Kingdom, the second-largest holder, saw its holdings rise to $1.010 trillion—breaking above the $1 trillion mark for the first time, an increase of $12 billion. China's holdings of U.S. Treasuries fell to $591 billion in August, down $27 billion from July.

headlines.title_en: Institutions: Shanghai office market demand picked up in Q3
headlines.summary_en: Recently, several commercial real estate agencies published their reports on Shanghai's real estate market for the third quarter of 2026. The data all show that Shanghai's commercial real estate market continues to see demand recovery and industrial upgrading reinforce each other: demand in the office market is picking up, activity in retail properties is increasing, and the investment market's total transaction value in the first three quarters grew by double digits year on year. (The Paper)

headlines.title: 斯里兰卡人民币清算行揭牌运行
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月17日讯，当地时间15日，由中国银行举办的斯里兰卡人民币清算行揭牌仪式在斯里兰卡科伦坡举行。当天，来自斯里兰卡政府部门及中斯两国企业、金融机构的200余位代表参加了揭牌仪式。目前，中国银行是唯一在斯里兰卡展业的中资金融机构。在中国和斯里兰卡两国央行的支持下，中国银行科伦坡分行获任斯里兰卡人民币清算行，这将提升跨境清算效率和人民币服务质效。

headlines.title_en: Sri Lanka RMB clearing bank officially opens
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: On October 15 local time, the unveiling ceremony for Bank of China's Sri Lanka RMB clearing bank was held in Colombo, Sri Lanka. More than 200 representatives from Sri Lankan government departments and Chinese and Sri Lankan enterprises and financial institutions attended the ceremony that day. Currently, Bank of China is the only Chinese financial institution operating in Sri Lanka. With the support of the central banks of China and Sri Lanka, Bank of China's Colombo branch was appointed as the RMB clearing bank for Sri Lanka, which will improve cross-border clearing efficiency and the quality and efficiency of RMB services.

headlines.title: 海康威视与中国电信国际亚太分部签署合作意向书
headlines.summary: 近日，在海康威视亚太制造业沙龙活动期间，海康威视与中国电信国际亚太分部签署合作意向书。双方将以新加坡产业数智化发展为合作重点，结合中国电信国际亚太分部在云网融合、数字基础设施及本地化服务等方面的能力，以及海康威视在物联感知、人工智能和行业数字化领域的技术积累，面向智慧校园、工业园区、智慧零售、商业建筑、智慧教育、数据中心等场景开展交流与合作。（新浪财经）

headlines.title_en: Hikvision signs letter of intent with China Telecom International Asia-Pacific
headlines.summary_en: Recently, during Hikvision's Asia-Pacific Manufacturing Salon event, Hikvision signed a letter of intent for cooperation with China Telecom Global's Asia-Pacific division. The two sides will focus on industrial digital and intelligent development in Singapore, combining China Telecom Global Asia-Pacific's capabilities in cloud-network integration, digital infrastructure and localized services with Hikvision's technological expertise in IoT sensing, artificial intelligence and industry digitalization, and will conduct exchanges and cooperation in scenarios including smart campuses, industrial parks, smart retail, commercial buildings, smart education and data centers. (Sina Finance)

headlines.title_en: CSRC issues huge fines: 3 individuals fined and confiscated over 500 million yuan in total for market manipulation and insider trading
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: On October 16, the CSRC issued an administrative penalty decision showing that three individuals were penalized for market manipulation and insider trading. Among them, Zhou Jifeng and Zhou Jihui were collectively fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling about RMB 328 million for manipulating the securities market; Zhou Jifeng was banned from the securities market for 5 years, and Zhou Jifeng was prohibited from trading in the securities market for 3 years. Chen Qiuhang was fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling nearly RMB 182 million for insider trading.

headlines.summary: 金十数据10月17日讯，匈牙利经济学家科莫罗茨基·伊什特万日前在出席第15届欧洲新思想论坛时表示，欧中在全球市场上虽存在竞争，但这并不妨碍彼此保持良好关系，双方应在公平竞争中相互学习，加强对话与合作。科莫罗茨基表示，面对复杂多变的国际形势，欧中更应坦诚交换意见，围绕具体问题开展务实商谈。科莫罗茨基认为，欧中在汽车、能源等领域具有较好的合作基础和发展空间。他不久前途经匈牙利南部时，看到当地正在建设的比亚迪汽车工厂，对其印象深刻。他说，受地缘政治局势等因素影响，欧洲能源供应面临挑战。欧中在风能、水能等可再生能源领域具有合作潜力。

headlines.title_en: Hungarian expert: EU and China should strengthen dialogue and cooperation in fair competition
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 17: Hungarian economist István Komoróczki said recently while attending the 15th European New Ideas Forum that although Europe and China compete in the global market, this does not prevent them from maintaining good relations, and the two sides should learn from each other in fair competition and strengthen dialogue and cooperation. Komoróczki said that amid the complex and volatile international situation, Europe and China should exchange views more candidly and conduct pragmatic discussions on specific issues. Komoróczki believes that Europe and China have a good foundation for cooperation and room for development in areas such as automobiles and energy. Not long ago, while passing through southern Hungary, he saw the BYD automobile plant under construction there and was deeply impressed. He said that affected by factors such as the geopolitical situation, Europe's energy supply faces challenges. Europe and China have cooperation potential in renewable energy fields such as wind and hydropower.

headlines.title: 证券日报：外部扰动不改A股中长期运行趋势
headlines.summary: 【证券日报：外部扰动不改A股中长期运行趋势】北京时间10月14日晚间，美国公布9月CPI（消费者物价指数）数据，市场对美联储10月加息的预期显著升温。有观点认为，如果通胀持续高于目标水平，美联储可能需要维持高利率更长时间，甚至进一步加息。拉长周期来看，美联储加息预期升温，对A股市场影响有限。当前，我国货币政策独立性强，流动性保持充裕；上市公司基本面持续修复，经营活力稳步回升。外部冲击更多体现为短期情绪扰动，不会导致A股趋势性调整。

headlines.title_en: Securities Daily: external disturbances will not change the medium- and long-term trend of A-shares
headlines.summary_en: [Securities Daily: External disturbances will not change A-shares' medium- and long-term trend] On the evening of October 14 Beijing time, the U.S. released September CPI (consumer price index) data, and market expectations for a Fed rate hike in October rose markedly. Some views hold that if inflation remains above target, the Fed may need to keep rates high for longer or even raise them further. Over a longer horizon, rising Fed rate-hike expectations have limited impact on the A-share market. At present, China's monetary policy is highly independent and liquidity remains ample; listed companies' fundamentals continue to recover and business vitality is steadily picking up. External shocks are mostly reflected as short-term sentiment disturbances and will not lead to a trend reversal in A-shares.

headlines.title: 中方呼吁加强全球气候治理
headlines.summary: 中国常驻联合国代表傅聪16日在联大主席召集的“适应未来的地球：以气候行动重建信任”高级别会议上发言，呼吁加强全球气候治理、加快绿色公正转型。发达国家应切实履行气候承诺，多边开发银行、私营部门等应加大气候投融资力度，帮助发展中国家解决资金、技术和能力不足问题。各国应积极开展早期预警、风险评估、防灾减灾等领域国际合作，推动完善应对损失与损害基金快速拨付机制。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: China calls for stronger global climate governance
headlines.summary_en: China's Permanent Representative to the UN Fu Cong spoke on the 16th at the high-level meeting convened by the President of the UN General Assembly titled "A Future-Fit Planet: Rebuilding Trust with Climate Action," calling for strengthening global climate governance and accelerating a green and just transition. Developed countries should earnestly honor their climate commitments, and multilateral development banks and the private sector should increase climate investment and financing to help developing countries address shortages of funds, technology and capacity. All countries should actively carry out international cooperation in areas such as early warning, risk assessment, and disaster prevention and reduction, and promote the improvement of a rapid disbursement mechanism for the loss and damage fund. (Xinhua News Agency)
